study type: secondary analysis of a retrospective cohort study
finding: Factors associated with lower 6-week postpartum follow-up were African-American race and <5 prenatal visits, while women with diabetes and women with a cesarean had higher follow-up.
mod_finding: Women with a cesarean delivery had higher 6-week postpartum follow-up (OR 2.61 (1.40-4.88)).
